 Prompt Clinic: From Bad Prompts to Better Results
 In-Person
 A hands-on session where students experiment with prompting, compare outputs, and learn how context, constraints, and iterative feedback affect results. We would incorporate discussions about accuracy, bias, and responsible AI use. 
 This event is part of the Gemini Student Ambassador Program, a partnership between NYU IT and Google.
